A '''Rescue Boat''' was a large [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used to travel over [[Water/Legends|water]].

==Characteristics==
Rescue [[Boat/Legends|Boats]] were large, aquatic craft capable of holding a great number of people. The Boats were equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] for protection. The main body had a transparent roof. A smaller, enclosed capsule sat behind and above the main body.

==History==
Three Rescue Boats were used by [[Rescue Flight]] to [[Raid on the Solleu River|evacuate]] people from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. All three Boats were successful and survived the mission.

==Behind the scenes==
Rescue Boats appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
